title: Weak Serre and coproduct closure of the coefficient-relative ind heart
statement: Let ell be prime, k a field of positive prime characteristic different from ell, X a separated finite-type k-scheme, and Lambda a commutative condensed coefficient ring certified by IsEllAdicCoefficient [def-sfb-adic-coefficient-certificate]. In the category of ordinary internal Lambda_X-module sheaves, let P be the ambient filtered-colimit closure, indexed in universe u+1, of IsConstructibleModuleObject [def-sfb-constructible-module]. Then P contains zero, is closed under kernels, cokernels and extensions, and under every ambient coproduct indexed in Type (u+1). This includes the empty scheme and empty coproduct.

source.place: Intermediate step of the proper truncation-tail argument

proof.text: Constructibility is invariant under isomorphisms and contains the zero module. Generic constructible extension closure and the split biproduct sequence give finite-coproduct closure. The proved abstract ind-coproduct theorem then gives every ambient coproduct, including the empty one.

For continuous finite fields and integer rings use the coefficient-relative finite weak Serre theorem. For the condensed algebraic closure local finite freeness gives equality with finite constant-model constructibility. Transport the existing canonical ind-heart kernel, cokernel and extension assertions across this equality. The schemes are Noetherian because they are finite type over a field.

theorem ellAdic_indConstructible_heart_closure :
    let P := ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1}
      (IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ X.left))
    P.ContainsZero ∧ P.IsClosedUnderKernels ∧ P.IsClosedUnderCokernels ∧
      P.IsClosedUnderExtensions ∧
      ∀ I : Type (u + 1), P.IsClosedUnderColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)
